description: Retrievable notes about Maya's past posts, audience and local brand landscape. Pipeline Manager (8082) serves this via the MCP rag_retrieve tool.

documents.title: Laksa from scratch in my HDB kitchen
documents.notes: Best performer to date. Noodle pull at 0:03 held retention to 61%. Comments asked repeatedly where to buy laksa paste.

documents.title: Chilli crab but make it one pan
documents.notes: Strong. Messy-hands close-up worked. Caption question drove 3x comment rate.

documents.title: 3-ingredient mango dessert
documents.notes: Underperformed badly. Audience did not come for dessert. Retention fell off a cliff at 0:06.

documents.title: Kaya toast at home vs Toh Kee
documents.notes: Comparison format performs. Named a real stall, stall owner commented.

documents.title: Audience shape
documents.notes: 72% Singapore, 61% aged 18-34, peak activity Tue and Thu 19:00-21:00 SGT and Sun 11:00 SGT. Saves outrank likes as the intent signal.

documents.title: Voice rules learned from comments
documents.notes: Audience rejects polished food-blogger phrasing. First person, present tense, one Singlish word maximum per script. Never claim 'best in Singapore' - the comments punish it.

documents.title: Laksa Lab, Tiong Bahru
documents.notes: Opened Apr 2026. 340 Instagram followers, no reels, no creator collabs. Owner Wei Sheng replies to DMs personally. Nearby creators charge SGD 350-600 for a single reel.

documents.title: Chilli Padi Sambal
documents.notes: DTC sambal brand, Shopee storefront only. Zero user-generated content. Has a Google Form for collab enquiries rather than an email address.

documents.title: Local rate benchmarks
documents.notes: SG micro creators 5k-15k followers: SGD 250-500 per TikTok, SGD 150-300 per IG reel, SGD 600-900 for a 3-post bundle. Food stalls prefer bundles with a usage licence.
